newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia labour leader's health worries children.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia labour leader's health worries children.

text.p: The children of jailed Indonesian labour leader Muchtar Pakpahan said on Tuesday their father was in poor health and expressed concern that the government had blocked him from being treated overseas.
In a statement, Pakpahan's three children called on the new British Labour government and the International Labour Organisation for support.

"According to the doctors treating him, he is suffering a clogged blood vessel in the brain as well as tumours in his lungs and liver. We are very concerned about the condition of our father," 16-year-old Binsar Pakpahan said, reading from a statement to reporters.

"Moreover, he was not treated intensively only because of his status as a prisoner. Our anxiety and concern has increased since the Justice Department prohibited our father from having surgery overseas," Binsar added.

One of Pakpahan's lawyers told Reuters that a letter from a prison official had been sent to the family that said the labour leader was not allowed to seek medical treatment overseas. The lawyer was not sure when the letter was issued.
Binsar was speaking on behalf of his brother Darta, 15, and sister Ruth, 11.
Pakpahan, head of the unrecognised Indonesian Labour Welfare Union (SBSI), was arrested last July in the wake of riots in Jakarta and charged with subversion which carries a maximum penalty of death.
His trial was suspended in March after he was admitted to a private Jakarta hospital suffering vertigo. For two months before that he had refused to be admitted to a military hospital.

Pakpahan was jailed in 1994 on charges that he incited racial rioting in the north Sumatran city of Medan in April that year after a series of strikes in nearby factories even though he was not in the city at the time of the disturbances.
He was freed on appeal and his conviction quashed by the Supreme Court. The conviction was reinstated in a highly unusual decision last year after his arrest on the subversion charge.
